note: Raster assets generated with gen-image.mjs (the Codex CLI's own built-in image tool, no other provider -- see references/generated-assets.md). gen-image.mjs appends one entry per file automatically, in this shape: { "file": "generated/<name>.png", "prompt": "<the exact prompt used, incl. the no-text/no-logo suffix>", "size": "1024x1024|1536x1024|1024x1536", "transparent": true|false, "scene": "<which scene/cue uses it>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "tool": "codex-cli <version>" }. Empty until a video actually needs a generated plate, texture or illustration -- most videos need none. Never a logo, wordmark, type, UI, product screenshot, or anything that carries a claim (those come from brand.json / real evidence, not a generator).
